job.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - E-Commerce / Shopify (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Frontend Engineer – E-Commerce / Shopify
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Great shop frontends need someone who understands the commerce logic behind every page – I customize storefronts, integrate PWA frontends and build the APIs behind them.

– JavaScript, PWA integration and storefront customization
– OCC REST / headless APIs for storefronts, PWA and third parties
– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Frontend Engineer | Storefronts, PWA, JavaScript & Headless APIs
tailoring.summary: E-commerce engineer with 5+ years building and extending large commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, with strong frontend focus. Experienced in storefront customization, JavaScript, responsive design and Progressive Web Application (PWA) integration on headless commerce, backed by OCC REST APIs she builds herself. Works with product catalogs, promotions and checkout-relevant order flows, executes CI/CD deployment cycles and performs code reviews. Uses AI tools daily in development and testing. Works in international agile teams with Scrum, Jira and Confluence.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: This role puts the storefront at the centre of e-commerce growth. I want to bring five years of storefront customization, PWA integration and headless API work from large commerce platforms into a team where frontend quality directly drives conversion. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! Your Senior Frontend Engineer (E-Commerce/Shopify) role fits well: 5+ years e-commerce – storefronts, JavaScript, PWA integration and headless APIs (Rockwell Automation, Shell). Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Frontend Engineer – E-Commerce / Shopify
en.hook: Great shop frontends need an engineer who understands the commerce logic behind every page. That has been my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I customize storefronts, integrate PWA frontends and build the headless APIs that feed them.

bullets.label: Storefront & PWA
bullets.text: Built APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends and customized storefronts and Backoffice components with JavaScript and responsive design.

bullets.label: Headless commerce
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Commerce logic
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) with Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing and customer data; developed and maintained Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Quality & releases
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit; perform code reviews, support production issues and give technical guidance to junior developers.

en.logistics: I work well with designers, backend teams and business owners to turn requirements into shipped features. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen Workwise.
